# 1. Setup & Libraries

```{r setup, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(vegan)
library(ggfortify)
library(ggvegan)
library(ggrepel)
library(cowplot)
library(viridis)

# Set global ggplot theme
theme_set(theme_classic())
```


# 2. Invertebrate Species List Generation
```{r}
# Load and filter invertebrate data
inverts_raw <- read_csv("../analysis_data/RLS_inverts_analysis_ready.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

inverts_southern <- inverts_raw %>% 
  filter(sector == "Southern")

# Export unique species list
inverts_list <- inverts_southern %>% 
  distinct(species_name)

write_csv(inverts_list, "../summary_data/inverts_list.csv")

# Compute most abundant invertebrates per site and survey
inverts_abund <- inverts_southern %>% 
  group_by(site_code, year, species_name) %>%
  summarise(total_abundance = sum(total), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(total_abundance))

write_csv(inverts_abund, "../summary_data/inverts_abundance_southern_GOC.csv")

```

# 3. Base Data Preparation for Fish Assemblages
```{r}
# Load raw fish data
fish_raw <- read_csv("../analysis_data/RLS_multivariate_fish.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# Clean and filter base fish dataset
lat_fish <- fish_raw %>% 
  filter(list == "Reef_fish") %>% 
  mutate(sector = if_else(sector == "Mornington", "Southern", sector)) %>% 
  filter(region %in% c("GOC", "GBR", "WA"),
         lat < -14.5 & lat > -17.5) %>% 
  mutate(t_id = paste(site_code, year, transect_2, sep = "_"))
```

# 4. NMDS Pipeline Function
```{r}
run_nmds_pipeline <- function(data, env_vars_cols, k_dims = 3, n_max = 100) {
  
  # 1. Create wide species abundance matrix
  species_mat <- data %>% 
    dplyr::select(t_id, Species_name, total) %>% 
    group_by(t_id, Species_name) %>% 
    summarise(overall_total = sum(total), .groups = "drop") %>% 
    pivot_wider(names_from = Species_name, values_from = overall_total, values_fill = 0)
  
  # Extract numeric community matrix
  comm_matrix <- as.data.frame(species_mat[,-1])
  
  # 2. Extract unique site environmental info
  site_info <- data %>% 
    dplyr::select(t_id, all_of(env_vars_cols)) %>% 
    distinct() %>% 
    mutate(across(where(is.character), as.factor))
  
  # 3. Run metaMDS
  nmds_model <- metaMDS(comm_matrix, k = k_dims, plot = FALSE, trymax = n_max)
  
  # 4. Extract Envfit scores
  env_fit <- envfit(nmds_model, site_info %>% dplyr::select(-t_id), permutations = 999, na.rm = TRUE)
  spp_fit <- envfit(nmds_model, comm_matrix, permutations = 999, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # 5. Compile Site Scores
  site_scores <- as.data.frame(scores(nmds_model, display = "sites")) %>% 
    bind_cols(site_info)
  
  # 6. Compile Species Scores & filter significant ones (p <= 0.001)
  fish_scores <- as.data.frame(scores(spp_fit, display = "vectors")) %>% 
    mutate(species = rownames(.), pval = spp_fit$vectors$pvals)
  
  top_fish <- fish_scores %>% filter(pval <= 0.001)
  
  # 7. Compile Environmental Scores
  env_scores <- as.data.frame(scores(env_fit, display = "vectors")) %>% 
    mutate(env_variables = rownames(.), pval = env_fit$vectors$pvals)
  
  return(list(
    model = nmds_model,
    site_scores = site_scores,
    top_fish = top_fish,
    env_scores = env_scores
  ))
}

```

# 5. Analysis 1: Multi-Region Fish Assemblage (GBR, WA, GOC)
Produces Figure 23 in the final report.
```{R}

# Run pipeline for GBR, WA, and GOC sites
res_regional <- run_nmds_pipeline(
  data = lat_fish, 
  env_vars_cols = c("site_code", "reef_name", "region", "zone"),
  k_dims = 3, 
  n_max = 100
)

# Main Site Plot
main_plot <- ggplot(res_regional$site_scores, aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = region), size = 1) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("#15B097", "#AF42AE", "#23A0C6")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#15B097", "#AF42AE", "#23A0C6")) +
  ggtitle(paste0("Stress = ", round(res_regional$model$stress, 2))) +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = 8))

# Fish Biplot
top_fish_reg <- res_regional$top_fish %>% 
  slice_head(n = 100) %>% 
  mutate(species = gsub("^(\\w)\\w*\\.(.*)$", "\\1.\\2", species)) %>% 
  filter((NMDS1 > 0.1 | NMDS1 < -0.1) & (NMDS2 > 0.1 | NMDS2 < -0.1))

biplot_regional <- ggplot() +
  geom_segment(data = top_fish_reg, aes(x = 0, xend = NMDS1, y = 0, yend = NMDS2), 
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm")), color = "gray10", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text_repel(data = top_fish_reg, aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2, label = species), 
                  size = 4, direction = "both", segment.size = 0.25, max.overlaps = 40, fontface = "italic") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-1.5, 1.5)) + 
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-1.2, 1.5)) +
  labs(x = "NMDS1", y = "NMDS2") +
  coord_equal()

# Combine plots
combined_plot_regional <- plot_grid(main_plot, biplot_regional, ncol = 2, labels = c("A", "B"))
combined_plot_regional
```

# 6. Analysis 2: Southern GOC Sites Only
Produces Figure 18 in the final report.
```{r}
fish_southern_sites <- lat_fish %>% filter(region == "GOC")

res_southern <- run_nmds_pipeline(
  data = fish_southern_sites, 
  env_vars_cols = c("site_code", "reef_name", "region", "zone", "geomorph"),
  k_dims = 3, 
  n_max = 1000
)

# South Site Plot
south_plot <- ggplot(res_southern$site_scores, aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = zone, shape = geomorph), size = 4) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("#23A0C6", "#D8CC34")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#23A0C6", "#D8CC34")) +
  ggtitle(paste0("Stress = ", round(res_southern$model$stress, 2))) +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = 8))

# South Fish Biplot
top_fish_south <- res_southern$top_fish %>% 
  slice_head(n = 30) %>% 
  mutate(species = gsub("^(\\w)\\w*\\s+(\\w+)$", "\\1. \\2", species)) %>% 
  filter((NMDS1 > 0.1 | NMDS1 < -0.1) & (NMDS2 > 0.1 | NMDS2 < -0.1))

biplot_southern <- ggplot() +
  geom_segment(data = top_fish_south, aes(x = 0, xend = NMDS1, y = 0, yend = NMDS2), 
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm")), color = "gray10", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text_repel(data = top_fish_south, aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2, label = species), 
                  size = 4, direction = "both", segment.size = 0.25, max.overlaps = 40, fontface = "italic") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-0.5, 0.5)) + 
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0.5, 0.5)) +
  labs(x = "NMDS1", y = "NMDS2") +
  coord_equal()

# Combine plots
combined_plot_southern <- plot_grid(south_plot, biplot_southern, ncol = 2, labels = c("A", "B"))
combined_plot_southern

```

# 7. Analysis 3: Longitudinal Report Sites (36 Sites)
Produces Figure 22 in the final report.
```{r}
report_fish <- fish_raw %>% 
  filter(report_site == "Yes") %>% 
  mutate(t_id = paste(site_code, year, transect_2, sep = "_"))

# Save report fish summary data
write_csv(report_fish, "../summary_data/report_fish.csv")

res_report <- run_nmds_pipeline(
  data = report_fish, 
  env_vars_cols = c("site_code", "reef_name", "region", "zone", "geomorph", "sector"),
  k_dims = 3, 
  n_max = 100
)

# Format factor orders and broader geomorphology categories
site_scores_report36 <- res_report$site_scores %>% 
  mutate(
    zone_sec = paste(sector, zone, sep = "_"),
    broad_geomorph = case_when(
      geomorph %in% c("Pinnacle", "Shoal") ~ "Submerged Pinnacle or Shoal",
      geomorph == "Fringing" ~ "Emergent Fringing Reef",
      TRUE ~ geomorph
    )
  )

# 36-Site Plot
report_plot <- ggplot(site_scores_report36, aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = sector, shape = broad_geomorph), size = 4) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("#27AD81", "#3B528B", "#AADC32", "#2C728E", "#FDE725", "#472D7B", "#440154")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#27AD81", "#3B528B", "#AADC32", "#2C728E", "#FDE725", "#472D7B", "#440154")) +
  ggtitle(paste0("Stress = ", round(res_report$model$stress, 2))) +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = 8))

# Report Fish Biplot
top_fish_report <- res_report$top_fish %>% 
  slice_head(n = 30) %>% 
  mutate(species = gsub("^(\\w)\\w*\\s+(\\w+)$", "\\1. \\2", species)) %>% 
  filter((NMDS1 > 0.1 | NMDS1 < -0.1) & (NMDS2 > 0.1 | NMDS2 < -0.1))

biplot_report <- ggplot() +
  geom_segment(data = top_fish_report, aes(x = 0, xend = NMDS1, y = 0, yend = NMDS2), 
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm")), color = "gray10", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text_repel(data = top_fish_report, aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2, label = species), 
                  size = 4, direction = "both", segment.size = 0.25, max.overlaps = 40, fontface = "italic") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-0.5, 0.5)) + 
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0.5, 0.5)) +
  labs(x = "NMDS1", y = "NMDS2") +
  coord_equal()

# Combine plots
combined_plot_report <- plot_grid(report_plot, biplot_report, ncol = 2, labels = c("A", "B"))
combined_plot_report

```
